Usage:
    coveragex lreport -s <branch> -t <branch> --source-directory <path> --report-input-directories <path1;path2> [options] [--json|-j]
    coveragex lreport -s <branch> -t <branch> --source-directory <path> --report-input-files <path1;path2> [options] [--json|-j]

Generates an incremental coverage report from an explicit local source tree.

Required:
    --source | -s <branch>                               Provide the source Git branch used for diff analysis.
    --target | -t <branch>                               Provide the target Git branch used for diff analysis.
    --source-directory | --sd <path>                     Provide the runtime source tree directory. It must point to the Git working tree root that CoverageX should use as the runtime source tree.

Options:
    --report-directory | -o | --rd <path>                Override the generated report output directory.
    --report-input-files | -f | --rf <paths>             Provide one or more explicit coverage XML input files separated by ';'. Repeatable.
    --report-input-directories | -i | --rid <paths>      Provide one or more directories separated by ';'. CoverageX recursively scans each provided directory for *.xml files. Repeatable.
    --runtime-branch | --rb | --run-branch <branch>      Provide the branch that the running project actually used to produce the coverage XML. If omitted, CoverageX uses --source.
    --report-type | -y | --rt <type>                     Append a ReportGenerator report type. Repeatable.
    --assembly-filter | --af <filter>                    Append an explicit assembly filter. Repeatable.
    --class-filter | --cf <filter>                       Append an explicit class filter. Repeatable.
    --file-filter | --ff <filter>                        Append an explicit file filter. Repeatable.
    --filter-mode | -m | --filter <mode>                 Choose diff, merge, or explicit filter behavior.
    --history-directory | --hd | --hist <path>           Provide the report history directory.
    --title | --ttl <text>  
[truncated]
